architecture.mechanism: High-granularity instantaneous crankshaft angular velocity measurement to resolve the integration of all motor and resisting force variables, enabling identification of specific torsional load peaks that cause bearing overload.
architecture.intervention: Use fine-granularity instant angle speed data from production engines to map the exact combustion timing and torque profiles generating destructive peak loads on the crankshaft bearings, then recalibrate factory ECU fuel injection timing and spark advance maps to eliminate those specific mechanical load spikes, correcting the root-cause defect rather than merely triggering a warning.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of the specific torsional vibration harmonics and peak cylinder pressure transients responsible for catastrophic crankshaft bearing failure by optimizing combustion phasing based on resolved mechanical interactions.
architecture.falsification_test: Record instant angle speed on the production engine using the novel sensing suite before and after applying the revised ECU calibration; if the amplitude of crankshaft angular velocity variation at the bearing-critical harmonic frequencies does not decrease by at least 20%, the intervention fails.
